title: Where a building faces upon two intersecting streets or public spaces and the total length of the exterior building
officialText: walls facing upon such streets or public spaces does not exceed 300 feet (91 140 mm) only one Fire Department connection need be installed provided the Fire Department connection is located within 15 feet (4572 mm) of the corner and on the street with the longest building frontage.
